answer: The tide counter is kept in vault and walnut shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2850 identities would post 4927 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
